_note: All thresholds live here. Placeholder defaults for slice 1; tune on real clips. No threshold may be hard-coded in src.
gate_note: Gate ratios are scale-normalised by shoulder width (see src/pose/gate.ts): bone_length_tol is the max fractional change of a scale-invariant bone length versus the median of recent history (0.3 = 30 percent); foreshortening_min is the minimum median projected/expected arm-bone ratio over smooth_frames recent frames; history_frames is how many recent lengths the drift reference covers.
